title: Paris Saint-Germain clinches a record-extending 14th French league title
summary: Paris Saint-Germain claimed their 14th French league title on Wednesday, sealing a fifth straight Ligue 1 crown with a 2-0 win away to closest challengers Lens. Khvicha Kvaratskhelia opened the scoring for Luis Enrique’s side before substitute Ibrahim Mbaye wrapped up the victory, as PSG continued their march toward a potential historic treble-winning seaso…
